'''Fantes Mer'darro''' was a native of [[Balosar/Legends|Balosar]],<ref name="SWI" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] which was [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] to the [[Balosar (species)/Legends|eponymous]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|57|Balosar}}</ref> By [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Mer'darro joined the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]],<ref name="SWI" /> the main security force of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]<ref name="Wing Guard DB">{{DB|organization|bespinwingguard|Wing Guard}}</ref> on the planet [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref> In his service to the Wing Guard, Mer'darro wore the standard [[Clothing/Legends|uniform]] of the organization, and the [[Antennapalps/Legends|antennapalps]] hidden under his [[Hat/Legends|cap]] helped Mer'darro sense suspicious people in Cloud City's many [[Casino/Legends|casinos]].<ref name="SWI" />

In 3 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Occupation of Bespin|occupied]] Bespin with intent to capture the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].<ref name="NEC" /> When the ''Millennium Falcon'' landed on Cloud City's [[Platform 327/Legends|Platform 327]], Mer'darro and other Wing Guard [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] accompanied the [[City/Legends|city's]] [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and his chief [[Administrator/Legends|administrative]] [[Aide/Legends|aide]], [[Lobot/Legends|Lobot]], in greeting the [[Light freighter/Legends|freighter's]] [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|occupants]]. Upon Lobot's command, the Wing Guard [[Troop/Legends|troopers]] left Calrissian and his aide alone with the ''Falcon''{{'s}} occupants, who were unaware Calrissian was in truth leading them into an Imperial trap.<ref name="ESB" /> A [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="FB" /> Balosar, Fantes Mer'darro had fair skin and dark hair.<ref name="SWI" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fantes Mer'darro was created for the 1980 [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']],<ref name="ESB" /> released on [[May 21]] of that year.<ref name="Empire Turns 40">{{ThisWeek|6UccH037VQ0|The Empire Strikes Back Turns 40, Queen's Peril Gets a Voice, and More!|sw_url=video/the-empire-strikes-back-turns-40-queen-s-peril-gets-a-voice-and-more}}</ref> Prior to the film's release, he first appeared simultaneously in [[Shep Steneman]]'s ''[[The Empire Strikes Back Storybook]]''<ref name="ESB storybook">''[[The Empire Strikes Back Storybook]]''</ref> and the film's [[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|novelization]], written by [[Donald F. Glut]].<ref name="ESB novel">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization]]</ref> Both of the publications were released on [[April 12]] of the same year.<ref name="Amazon-RandomHouse">{{Amazon|url=Empire-Strikes-Back-Storybook/dp/0394844149|text=The Empire Strikes Back Storybook}}</ref><ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> Mer'darro's scene was filmed between [[April 5]] and April 12, [[1979]] on stage 2 of [[Elstree Studios]].<ref name="Making Of TESB">''[[The Making of The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref>

On [[March 11]], [[2014]],<ref name="Titan">{{TitanMagazines|url=t/star-wars-insider/us/148|text=Star Wars Insider Issue #148}}</ref> Mer'darro was first named by the article "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery: The Cloud City Wing Guards]]," published in the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine's [[Star Wars Insider 148|148th issue]]. [[Kevin Beentjes]], [[Sander de Lange]], and [[Tim Veekhoven]], who wrote the article,<ref name="SWI" /> stated that nearly all of the Wing Guard members described were "good guys" who opposed the corruption that was prevalent under the leadership of Cloud City's previous Baron Administrator, [[Dominic Raynor]]&mdash;with the exception of the ones who had been previously established to have been corrupt. They further talked about [[Tuckerization|naming]] Mer'darro after fellow ''[[Star Wars]]'' fan Stefan Pfister, and also making him a Balosar "to break to mold of having only [[Human/Legends|human]] characters."<ref name="FB" />
